healthcareSystem: Public healthcare system severely underfunded. Private clinics in Yangon and Mandalay offer better care. Medical evacuation to Thailand or Singapore recommended for serious conditions.
qualityNotes: Healthcare is very limited, particularly since the 2021 political crisis. Private hospitals in Yangon offer the best available care. For serious conditions, medical evacuation to Bangkok is standard. Bring all medications you might need.
pharmacyHours: Pharmacies in cities open daily 8am-9pm. Very limited in rural areas.
pharmacyTips: AA Pharmacy and City Pharmacy are larger chains in Yangon. Many medications available OTC but quality can vary. Counterfeit medicines are a concern — buy from reputable pharmacies in cities only.
prescriptionRules: Very relaxed prescription requirements. Most medications available without prescription. Quality and authenticity are concerns. Bring essential medications from home.

restrictedMeds.name: Opioid medications
restrictedMeds.note: Myanmar has extremely strict drug laws. Bring documentation.

restrictedMeds.name: Amphetamines/stimulants
restrictedMeds.note: Extremely strict penalties including death penalty.

bringDocumentation: Carry a detailed doctor's letter in English for ALL prescription medications. Myanmar has extremely strict drug laws. Keep all medications in original packaging with clear labels.

travelInsurance.tips: Travel insurance with medical evacuation coverage is ABSOLUTELY ESSENTIAL. Must cover evacuation to Bangkok, Thailand or Singapore. Healthcare in Myanmar is severely limited.

recommended: Yellow fever (required if arriving from endemic area)
vaccinations.notes: Malaria is present in many regions. Dengue fever is common. Consult a travel medicine specialist well before departure.

waterNotes: Do NOT drink tap water. Use bottled water only. Avoid ice in drinks except at upscale hotels. Use bottled water for brushing teeth.
foodSafetyTips: Eat freshly cooked food only. Avoid raw vegetables, salads, and unpeeled fruit. Street food should be very hot and freshly prepared. Mohinga (fish soup) and grilled dishes from busy stalls are safest.
medicalTourismNote: Myanmar is not a medical tourism destination. Travelers needing medical care typically evacuate to Thailand or Singapore.
metaDescription: Complete health & medication guide for traveling to Myanmar. Emergency numbers, pharmacy tips, limited hospital options, vaccination requirements, and essential medical evacuation insurance info.

hospitals.name: Pun Hlaing Siloam Hospital
hospitals.notes: Best private hospital in Myanmar. International standards. English-speaking doctors.

hospitals.name: Asia Royal Hospital
hospitals.notes: Private hospital with English-speaking doctors. Good for tourist medical needs.

hospitals.name: Mandalay General Hospital
hospitals.notes: Main public hospital in Mandalay. Basic facilities. For serious conditions, evacuation recommended.

dentalCare.availability: Basic dental care available in Yangon. Very limited elsewhere.
dentalCare.notes: Dental facilities are basic. For anything beyond emergencies, consider evacuation to Bangkok.
dentalCare.emergencyTip: For dental emergencies in Yangon, visit Pun Hlaing Siloam Hospital or Asia Royal Hospital.

mentalHealth.englishTherapists: Very limited. Some available through international clinics in Yangon.
mentalHealth.notes: Mental health services are extremely limited in Myanmar. For English-speaking support, contact your embassy.

accessibilityInfo.overview: Accessibility infrastructure is very limited throughout Myanmar. Most buildings and transport are not accessible.
accessibilityInfo.hospitalAccess: Private hospitals in Yangon have some accessibility. Public hospitals have very limited accessibility.
accessibilityInfo.transport: No accessible public transport. Private vehicles are the main option. Roads are often poor quality.
accessibilityInfo.tips: Myanmar is very challenging for travelers with mobility limitations. Plan carefully, use private transport, and contact your hotel in advance. Major temples (Shwedagon) have some accessible routes.

covidStatus.entryRequirements: Check current requirements before travel as they may change. Some documentation may be required.
covidStatus.testing: Tests available at private hospitals in Yangon.
covidStatus.notes: Check latest travel advisories before visiting Myanmar.

insuranceClaimProcess: Private hospitals provide English-language documentation. Public hospitals provide basic receipts in Burmese. Medical evacuation to Thailand is common and expensive — ensure insurance covers this. Keep all documentation.
